The '''HyperMatter shipping warehouse''' was a warehouse in the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]], a [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] refinery on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Galactic War]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces infiltrated the warehouse and planted bugs on the hypermatter shipments in order to track their buyers.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The HyperMatter shipping warehouse is the site of the Republic mission "Eyes and Ears," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1 along with the rest of the Black Hole.<ref name="TOR" />
